repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oyZgRX9Qc1ZHsMRQp

An update to the description above. Since #34494 `b7751333` (contract review 6933112344 S3), the reading no longer digests the stored bodies. It digests `id`, `type`, `name`, `namespace`, `package_id`, `bundle_member`, `extends`, `strategy`, `state`, `version`, `checksum` and `updated_at`. The class this card exists to close is now narrower: a writer that bypasses the engine and rewrites a body while leaving `version`, `checksum` and `updated_at` exactly as they were. Today that class is bounded only by the compile cache's 10-bound age cap.

The same synthetic run on the bookkeeping-only reading took 0.3, 2.2 and 21 ms at 100, 1 000 and 10 000 rows. On a showcase store seeded with 5 000 rows, a renewed bundle reload took 150–192 ms with 42 queries, against a 491 ms recompile (delta 6933554702 on #34494). The column this card asks for would let the reading drop to one small value and close the bypass class without the cap.

## Triage: first touch → `domain:server` · p2 · theme: performance · 2026-11-17T00:47Z

⛔ Not a claim.

The compile cache confirms freshness every 30 s by hashing every `sys_metadata` row, bodies included, which reads the whole table. A write-moved column would make that check one indexed read. This is a performance follow-up of #34206, which the maintainer raised to p1: **p2**.

## Premise corrected · written at 2026-11-17T03:55Z · ⛔ not a claim

Area `o2-G` measured this card on `origin/main`, and the seat accepts the reading. The premise holds, but on narrower ground than the body states. Since #34494 (`b7751333`), `readStoreMark` in `meta-compile-cache.ts` (around line 318) digests only id, type, name, namespace, package_id, bundle_member, extends, strategy, state, version, checksum and updated_at. It does not read `body`. That is already noted in this card's 00:27Z update and in #34494 comments 6933083314 and 6933554702. So the "bodies included" wording in the body and in the triage note is out of date.

**What remains to close:** a write that bypasses the engine and changes `body` without moving `version`, `checksum` or `updated_at`. Today only the age cap on the ten bounded entries covers that case. The card's route stands: a write-moved mark on `sys_metadata` (a column, or a store-side counter) that also moves on writes that bypass the engine, with a migration for existing stores. That makes it a large card (L, cross-driver, likely `Metadata-protocol` other than `none`), so it gets its own card thread under area `o2-G`. It starts from `main` after PR #34592 merges, because both touch `meta-compile-cache.ts`.

Acceptance, narrowed: a write that bypasses the engine and changes only `body` invalidates the cached compile on the next read, with no age cap needed for it, and the digest no longer has to cover the fields the mark replaces.

## 维护者速读 · 待裁

**一句话问题：** 元数据编译缓存要能发现「绕过平台、直接用 SQL 只改了正文」的写。能做到这一点的只有数据库自己，也就是平台第一次引入数据库触发器。现行 ADR-0156 D1(b) 把这类写交给时间上限兜底(最长约 5 分钟可见)。

**现状(读码加一次 SQLite 探针):** 缓存确认时摘 `sys_metadata` 十二列记账字段，不读正文。平台自己的写会动这些列，所以 30 秒内可见。只有仓外的裸 SQL 只改正文、不动记账列时，要等 10 个周期的年龄上限(默认约 5 分钟)。仓里今天没有任何平台自建的数据库触发器。

**Governing text:** ADR-0156 D1(b)(绕过引擎的写由时间界覆盖)、D2(计数器在进程内，不上线路)。

| 选项 | 做什么 | 客户可感知后果 | 工作量 |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| A | SQL 类数据库用触发器维护一个写计数，确认时读这一个值;读不到就退回今天的摘要。MongoDB、OData 不变 | 运维用 SQL 只改元数据正文，30 秒内生效，不再等约 5 分钟;读取成本从约 21 ms 降到约 0.004 ms(1 万行) | L/XL:四种 SQL 方言的触发器和迁移;托管 MySQL 常缺建触发器的权限，要降级告警;若做成驱动契约，还要改 spec(交你审批) |
| B | 在平台写入路径上加一列写序号，不用触发器 | 关不掉裸 SQL 这一类，和现状差不多 | M;不推荐 |
| C | 不做，维持 ADR-0156 D1(b) 的时间上限，关卡 | 裸 SQL 只改正文最长约 5 分钟才可见;平台自己的写不受影响 | 0 |

os-decision-facets
① 项目长远合理性:A 是唯一能关掉这一类的形状，但要引入平台的第一个数据库触发器，四种方言各一套 DDL,权限不足时还要降级;C 沿用已裁的时间界。
② 实际业务拉动：仓内找不到绕过平台、用 SQL 改元数据正文的写者;仓外只有运维 SQL 和导入工具这类假设场景，没有客户撞上的记录。零实测拉动。
③ 防 AI 犯错:AI 写元数据走平台写入路径，记账列一定会动，不落在这一类;A 和 C 对 AI 写应用没有差别。
④ 创业阶段不扩散:C 最省;A 引入一整套新的存储侧机制。
Prior rulings read: ADR-0156 D1(b)、D2;cluster.mdx §6.1(跨节点元数据版本已退役。卡线程读为各节点读自己存储里的一个值，不算线路版本，席位同意这个读法);#34494 评论 6933083314、6933554702。
Analysis-tier: seat default.

**推荐:C**(卡线程的推荐是「如果要做就选 A,否则选 C」;席位推荐 C)。只看①会倾向 A;②④ 翻转了它：零实测拉动，而 A 是一整套新的存储机制。如果你认为运维用 SQL 改元数据必须 30 秒内可见，选 A,并同时定两件事：做成驱动契约(spec,交你审批)还是由元数据层按方言另建;建不了触发器时是降级告警还是拒绝启动。
**裁后执行：** 选 C ⇒ 席位按 not planned 关卡，理由引 ADR-0156 D1(b)。选 A ⇒ 卡回 `pm:queue`,按你定的两个子项开卡线程(区 o2-G)。选 B ⇒ 不推荐;若选，回 `pm:queue` 并写明它关不掉的那一类。

Ruled: C · written at 2026-11-17T04:02Z
Ruling-ref: the maintainer's words in the fleet project at 2026-11-17T04:02Z, answering the decision analysis 6937838431: 「有人绕过平台直接用 SQL 改元数据正文，不考虑这种情况」.

Closed as not planned. A write that bypasses the platform and changes only the metadata body stays covered by ADR-0156 D1(b)'s time bound (10 × TTL), as it is today. No database trigger, no write-moved column. The pin `the stored body is not read at the bound` in `meta-compile-cache.test.ts` keeps holding that behaviour. `needs-user-decision` comes off in this stroke.
